mapper.sql: session_id, total_score, repayment_history_score, debt_level_score, credit_period_score, credit_pattern_score, non_financial_score, score_calculated_dttm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_evaluation_result ( session_id, total_score, repayment_history_score, debt_level_score, credit_period_score, credit_pattern_score, non_financial_score, score_calculated_dttm ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{totalScore}, #{repaymentHistoryScore}, #{debtLevelScore}, #{creditPeriodScore}, #{creditPatternScore}, #{nonFinancialScore}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE credit_evaluation_result SET total_score = #{totalScore}, repayment_history_score = #{repaymentHistoryScore}, debt_level_score = #{debtLevelScore}, credit_period_score = #{creditPeriodScore}, credit_pattern_score = #{creditPatternScore}, non_financial_score = #{nonFinancialScore}, score_calculated_dttm = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM credit_evaluation_result ORDER BY total_score DESC, score_calculated_dttm DESC
SELECT FROM credit_evaluation_result WHERE total_score BETWEEN #{minScore} AND #{maxScore} ORDER BY total_score DESC, score_calculated_dttm DESC
